title: pyrus americana var. microcarpa
intro: Pyrus americana var. microcarpa, commonly known as the American Cherry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include aiding in digestion, reducing inflammation, and serving as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate coughs, and act as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus americana var. microcarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
